Glossary · Technical analysis

RSI RSI

Relative Strength Index: a 0 to 100 momentum measure. Above 70 is often overbought; below 30 oversold.

हिंदी में: RSI

रिलेटिव स्ट्रेंथ इंडेक्स: 0 से 100 का मोमेंटम मापक। 70 से ऊपर अक्सर ओवरबॉट; 30 से नीचे ओवरसोल्ड।

How it is used in the lessons

RSI (relative strength index): a 0 to 100 scale over 14 periods.

From Technical Analysis

Momentum indicators (RSI, MACD, stochastic): measure the speed of price moves and whether they are speeding up or slowing down.

From Technical Indicators

Buy: price touches or nears the 20-day EMA and forms a bullish candle (hammer or engulfing) with RSI turning up from around 40 to 50.
